title: Restore Core live MCP façade over the Commercial plug
goal: Make Core's GMCP MCP registry discover configured servers and configure them through the existing authenticated plane-bus boundary, while keeping outbound MCP transport and credentials in Commercial Apps.
deps: T-PLUGPORTS-1 (do not edit its claimed paths; only the Core façade is in scope)

results.boundary: Core GMCP registry façade only; calls cross tools.mcp.remote_execute and the composition root routes to the Commercial ecosystem_hub.mcp.call plug when wired, while the existing guarded local transport remains the standalone fallback. Server admission uses the daemon adapter plane; no new dependency, Minijinja, Windows, Jan artifact or credential change.
results.coverage: Configured MCP servers are read from both native mcp_config.json key spellings, live tools are discovered in bounded parallel plane-bus probes, calls and auto-configuration use the existing composition-root boundaries, and wildcard proxies remain the bounded fallback when probing is unavailable. Core does not own the commercial transport.
results.gmcp_evidence: Requirement phase recorded 54 checks against 94db45ed8d0d7caeaf3b3fa91bf369fcfc4880e8 in 9e05d43625974e8a45baa3575d5b4c5f034e058e; mastery phase recorded 9 checks against 9e05d43625974e8a45baa3575d5b4c5f034e058e in b0f166374.
results.limitations: Discovery is bounded by a 12-second aggregate deadline and per-request lease/handshake budgets; it returns config-only wildcard proxies when live probing cannot produce tools. Package admission supports HTTP(S) endpoints or the existing npx package form, and the Commercial plug remains the owner of outbound transport and trust policy when wired.
